title: A Modular Taxonomy for Hate Speech Definitions and Its Impact on Zero-Shot LLM Classification Performance

bias_targets.methodology: Zero-shot text classification on three hate speech datasets (HateCheck, Learning from the Worst, Measuring Hate Speech) using structured prompts that vary the conceptual elements of the hate speech definition provided to the model (e.g., specifying the target, problematic content, implicit hate, or exceptions). The evaluation measures macro-F1 scores and analyzes error distributions across specific hate speech functionalities (e.g., explicit hate, implicit hate, leetspeak, counter-speech).
